newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Posadas restarted as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Posadas restarted as buy.

text.p: Merrill Lynch in Mexico said Monday it had restarted coverage of Mexican hotel manager Grupo Posadas with a buy rating, up from a previous neutral rating.

The brokerage also lifted its long-term recommendation for the stock to buy from accumulate, according to analyst Michel Morin. Morin and analyst Pablo Riveroll said in a report the rating change reflects the company's improved financial position and an expected rise in occupancy rates.
"We expect sales to grow by 11 percent in 1997 and 1998, while operating profit should grow by 16 percent and 12 percent, respectively," the analysts wrote.

The stock has underperformed the market by 59 percent since January 1995 but should grow through acquisitions, they added. The brokerage's rating does not reflect the expected growth, Riveroll and Morin said.
Posadas has refinanced its debt to longer maturities and more favorable conditions, they said.
The company's shares were 0.10 peso to 3.80 pesos at midday Monday.
